name: usaspending
description: USAspending.gov is the official U.S. federal spending database. This CLI calls its public API (api.usaspending.gov, no auth needed) to search awards and transactions, open award, recipient, agency, state and federal-account profiles, break spending down by category, and request bulk downloads.

commands.name: search-transactions
commands.summary: Keyword search of contract transactions (award types A/B/C/D), with sorting and paging

params.name: keyword
params.description: Free-text keyword to match in transaction and award text

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: count-keyword-transactions
commands.summary: Count transactions matching a keyword, broken out by award group (contracts, grants, idvs, loans, direct_payments, other)

commands.name: summarize-keyword-spending

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the action-date range, YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

notes: Public API, no auth. All commands hit https://api.usaspending.gov.
Amounts are USD. Fiscal years run Oct 1 to Sep 30 (FY2026 = 2025-10-01..2026-09-30). Search date ranges cannot start before 2007-10-01.
Award ids are the generated ids like CONT_AWD_<PIID>_<agency>_<parent PIID or -NONE->_<agency or -NONE->. Search results return them as generated_internal_id.
Recipient ids are hashes with a level suffix: -C child, -P parent, -R recipient. Get them from search-recipients or from the recipient_id field of category results.

Agencies are addressed by toptier_code (e.g. 097 DOD, 089 DOE; see list-agencies). States are addressed by FIPS in get-state-profile and get-state-awards-by-type, and by two-letter code in the search commands.
search-transactions and the award searches are fixed to contract award types A/B/C/D, which is what the web app sends by default.
Responses often include a 'messages' array with API warnings (deprecations, ignored filters). These are informational.
list-award-transactions and search-recipients were held or failed during recording, so their request shapes come from the public API docs and were not verified live.
request-award-download only starts a server-side file generation job and changes no data. Poll get-download-status until status is 'ready', then fetch file_url.
